scope: independent deterministic PUB-01 scripted acceptance and evidence integrity
hash_policy: Manifest includes report, input metadata, all run artifacts and byte-for-byte official source copies. Manifest excludes only itself. Report contains no manifest hash, preventing a circular hash. Validation requires an independently recorded manifest SHA-256.
language_scope: Conservative explicit English PUB-01 scripted phrases. Unsupported paraphrases do not pass. This is not a general LLM conversation judge.
limits: No network, models, credentials, live simulation, Freya publication or official competition score. Valid integrity alone does not mean the three runs passed. Anchor compromise or fabricated events cannot be ruled out by hashes.
